digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify matrix / GitHub Actions CI workflow
propositions: Coverage instrumentation (pytest-cov with branch=true and fail_under=70) is currently collected independently on all three Ubuntu cells (3.11, 3.12, 3.13) despite identical source code with no version-specific branches, creating redundant measurement overhead.

Local measurement shows coverage tracing adds ~34 wall seconds per uninstrumented cell (median delta between instrumented and uninstrumented runs), confirming real runner-occupancy cost without distinct verdicts.

Ubuntu Python 3.13 should be designated the sole coverage-collecting cell while retaining all four cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) for behavioral compatibility testing, with 3.11 and 3.12 running the same pytest tiers uninstrumented.

The workflow contract must enforce that exactly Ubuntu 3.13 receives both coverage flags and all other cells receive neither, using non-empty truthy coverage strings and empty-string fallback to avoid GitHub Actions falsy-empty-string trap.

OSS precedent survey (Django, NumPy, SciPy) confirms consensus that selective coverage collection on a primary or dedicated configuration while broader compatibility jobs run uninstrumented is accepted industry practice.

Pre-merge Verify baseline (run 31798375024, 1879s wall clock) and post-merge observation (via inedible-subsimious-brahmancow) must record default-suite step durations for Ubuntu 3.11 and 3.12 to quantify runner-seconds freed by removing duplicate tracing.
